answer: Comet-sweep cipher-thread: every identity carries one unbroken thread of completed jobs, each receipt cipher-chained to the last, so a fake cannot invent history — peers replay the chain and one broken link fails the whole thread. A new identity needs 200 verified jobs (~40 hours of real work) before high-value work. Each epoch a comet sweep spot-checks 5% of threads, demanding a live proof within 10 minutes; 1,000 clones would need 200,000 real jobs and cannot answer 50 live proofs. Honest agents pay the 40 hours once. Limit: a patient farm can still grow threads over months.
